topic: Foundations of Linear Algebra: From Span to Basis

sections.title: Prerequisite Refresh: Vectors as Arrows
lecture_lines: Vectors act as directed arrows in 2D space.
Add vectors using the head-to-tail method.
animations: Create two 2D vectors u and v with tail at origin. Color them #FF6347 (Tomato) and #4682B4 (SteelBlue) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Highlight the head of u with a glowing #FF6347 dot.
Transition u and v to represent scalars c1*u + c2*v [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Linear Combinations and Span
lecture_lines: A linear combination scales and adds vectors.
Span is every point a combination can reach.
Two non-parallel vectors sweep the entire plane.
animations: Show span as the full plane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg] covered by combinations of u and v.
Animate a point moving along c1*u + c2*v to trace the plane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg].
Display the resulting span area in #808080 (Gray) with 30% opacity.

sections.title: Linear Dependence: The Redundant Vector
lecture_lines: Linear dependence occurs when vectors are redundant.
One vector can be formed by the others.
Removing redundant vectors maintains the same span.
animations: Show three vectors where one is a scaled version of another [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Flash the redundant vector in #FFD700 (Gold) to indicate dependency.
Fade out the redundant vector to show the reduced span remains the same.

sections.title: The Concept of a Basis
lecture_lines: A Basis is a minimalist spanning set.
Basis vectors must be linearly independent.
Every point has unique basis coordinates.
animations: Display two linearly independent vectors. Color them #00FF7F (SpringGreen).
Animate the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] appearing, demonstrating how these vectors define the plane.
Show arbitrary vector w as a unique linear combination of these basis vectors.

sections.title: Summary & Visualization
lecture_lines: Basis vectors define an efficient coordinate system.
animations: Summarize the core concepts using the map [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg]. Use #FFFFFF (White) for text.
Animate a smooth zoom-out showing the interplay of span, dependence, and basis, keeping the map [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg] visible in the background.
Final appearance of the summary text, highlighted with #FFD700 (Gold) flashing alongside the map [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg].
